name: Moldova

flag.description: A vertical tricolour of blue, yellow and red, with the coat of arms on the yellow band: a golden eagle holding a cross in its beak and a shield bearing an aurochs head.
flag.symbolism: The colours reflect the shared heritage with Romania; the aurochs head was the emblem of the medieval Principality of Moldavia.

hook: Moldova is Romania's tricolour with a golden eagle clutching a bull's-head shield in the middle; Andorra's crest has no eagle.
trivia: Moldova and Andorra have the only national flags depicting cattle.
The Mileștii Mici wine cellars hold the Guinness record for the largest wine collection in the world.
